mission.title: The Stolen Artifact
mission.description: Recover a stolen artifact for the Merovingian.

phase.briefing: As you may have heard, we recently had an artifact stolen from us that requires recovery. The prized artifact was lifted by a small band of renegade Exiles that think they can take what belongs to us. Our current lead will send you right into the den of thieves that so foolishly ran off with the Merovingian's possession. Honestly, I would rather select someone else for this task, but it would seem that you're the only person available at the moment. Prove to me that I made the right decision.

enter.say: The Exiles are scattered all over the area ... I'm afraid that I don't know the exact location of the artifact, so you will have to turn the place upside down looking for it. Make it messy.

objective.text: Find the artifact. Find information on who has the artifact

phase.briefing: I've sent you the address of Pemberton's Laboratory. Only she can decipher the documents.

objective.text: Get the dossier on Danby from Pemberton's computer

phase.briefing:
Captain Arcturus and his crew are inside a nearby REP. Find Arcturus and get the artifact from him by any means possible.
You've been updated with proper coordinates from the REP.

enter.say: The Redpill Extraction Point is inside this building.

objective.text: Kill Arcturus and the crew of the Prodito

phase.briefing: You've been updated with the drop-off point. Head there now before additional attempts are made to steal the artifact.

enter.say: Ensure that the artifact is returned to Bertrand.
